topic: How many UPI payments happen in India every second?

hook.text: How many UPI payments happen in India every second?

lines.say: In October twenty twenty-six, India made twenty five point four seven billion UPI payments. A brand new record!
lines.cap: October 2026: 25.47 BILLION UPI payments. A brand new record!

lines.say: Divide that by every second of the month, and you get about nine and a half thousand payments. Every. Single. Second.
lines.cap: Divide by every second of the month: about 9,500 payments. Every. Single. Second.

lines.say: And the money, old chap? Over one lakh crore rupees. Per day. My monocle is rather fogged.
lines.cap: And the money, old chap? Over ₹1 LAKH CRORE. Per DAY. My monocle is rather fogged.

lines.text: First time above ₹1 lakh crore a day

lines.say: Four years ago, in October twenty twenty-two, it was just seven point three billion a month. Now it's three and a half times bigger!
lines.cap: October 2022: just 7.3 billion a month. Now? 3.5x BIGGER!

lines.say: Which app do you pay with? Tell us in the comments!
lines.cap: Which app do you pay with? Tell us in the comments!

title: India makes 9,500 UPI payments EVERY SECOND 🤯
description: 25.47 billion UPI payments in October 2026, a new record. That's about 9,500 every second and over ₹1 lakh crore a day. The panel crunches the numbers. Which UPI app do you use? Tell us in the comments!
